d: Best friends Raja and Ravi are in love with Radha. This creates differences between the two. When Raja needs Ravi's help, Ravi demands a steep price from Radha to save him.
A thief and a barber, both identical in appearance, experience life-changing events.
Gopal and Rajeswari live a happy married life with their children. However, things start to change when he finds out that his wife suffers from blood cancer.
The story follows the emotional journey of a young man caught in a web of romance, betrayal, and heartbreak as he discovers hidden truths about the people he trusts
